title: Studio OWD panel: saving "Controlled by parent" on a detail whose master_detail is not yet required answers 409 DESTRUCTIVE_CHANGE with no way forward
body:
domain:devx#1 · sunhaolin · session_017xRBcVkGJizGH7raJHhAvL

Filing gate: ① a product defect, a QA run clause fail (studio-authoring.access-owd-and-suggestions acceptance[1]).

## Reproduction
1. Boot the showcase and sign in as admin. `POST /api/v1/packages {"manifest":{"id":"com.qa.rnine","name":"QA R9","version":"0.1.0","type":"app","namespace":"qnine"}}`.
2. `PUT /api/v1/meta/object/qnine_project?mode=draft&package=com.qa.rnine` with `{"name":"qnine_project","sharingModel":"private","fields":{"name":{"type":"text"}}}`.
3. `PUT /api/v1/meta/object/qnine_step?mode=draft&package=com.qa.rnine` with `{"name":"qnine_step","sharingModel":"private","fields":{"name":{"type":"text"},"project":{"type":"master_detail","reference":"qnine_project"}}}`. `required` is not set and the table is empty.
4. `POST /api/v1/packages/com.qa.rnine/publish-drafts`.
5. Open `/_console/studio/com.qa.rnine/access` → "Record sharing (OWD)". On QN Step choose "Controlled by parent — inherited from the master record" (the row shows "By parent → qnine_project"), then click "Save 1 change(s)".
6. Expected: the draft saves. Choosing controlled-by-parent makes the master_detail required, and on an empty table that is safe, or the panel asks for confirmation.
7. Actual: `PUT /api/v1/meta/object/qnine_step?mode=draft&package=com.qa.rnine&surface=studio` → 409 DESTRUCTIVE_CHANGE "Field 'project' is now required but has no default value — existing rows with null values may fail validation. — re-submit with ?force=true to proceed." The banner shows the message, the row stays "Unsaved", and the panel has no confirm or force control. The offered option cannot be saved. Reproduced twice on fresh loads.

Control: after making `project` `required: true` through the API (`?force=true`, then publish), the same panel save answers 200, and the live object reads controlled_by_parent.

## Mechanism
The panel's save implies a required flip on the master_detail field, and the destructive-change guard refuses it without `?force=true`. The panel neither offers the force path (with the confirm the guard asks for) nor skips the guard when the table is empty.
